## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does. Link the issue or task ID.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Mark anything not verified.
For generation/model changes include versions, songs/split, seeds, parameters, and comparisons.
For detector changes include false positives, recall, abstentions, and supported scope.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and existing standard generation still works where affected.
- [ ] Chinese/English documentation and interface text are updated where relevant.
- [ ] Sources and licences of new code, assets, or models are recorded.
- [ ] `docs/TASKS.md` reflects the verified result where a tracked task is affected.
